instruction: Extract papers from references.docx, get their DBLP BibTeX entries (published versions), and write them to 'references.bib' with blank lines separating each entry for readability.

metadata.explanation: Validates BibTeX file content and formatting. Checks: (1) entries match expected papers from references.docx (Spider, SParC, CoSQL, Attention is All you Need, BERT, Language Models are Few-Shot Learners) via fuzzy title matching (0.1 per paper, max 0.6), (2) DBLP format validation (biburl/bibsource fields or DBLP: entry keys) and published versions (has venue/journal/booktitle fields) (0.2 for 80%+ compliance), (3) proper blank line separation (5+ blank lines for 6 entries, 0.2 for correct formatting). Total score combines content matching + DBLP validation + formatting.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.0: No entries; 0.1-0.6: Content matching (0.1 per correct paper from Spider/SParC/CoSQL/Attention/BERT/GPT-3); +0.1-0.2: DBLP format and published versions (0.2 if 80%+ entries have DBLP fields and venues); +0.1-0.2: Proper blank line separation (0.2 if 5-10 blank lines). Max 1.0 for all criteria met.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is comprehensive: Getter extracts titles, authors, venues, and DBLP indicators from BibTeX entries
Content matching implemented: Metric defines expected papers (Spider, SParC, CoSQL, Attention, BERT, GPT-3) and fuzzy matches against extracted titles
DBLP format validation present: Checks for DBLP-specific indicators (biburl, bibsource=dblp, DBLP: prefix in keys)
Published version verification: Verifies presence of venue/journal/booktitle fields to distinguish from preprints
Proper scoring breakdown: 0.6 for content matching (0.1 per paper), 0.2 for DBLP format compliance, 0.2 for blank line formatting
Edge cases handled: Returns zero score for empty files, partial credit for incomplete matches
Minor issue: Regex pattern in getter (line 40) may not handle all BibTeX entry variations (nested braces, complex formatting)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using a proper BibTeX parser library (like bibtexparser) instead of regex for more robust entry extraction
Add validation that the number of matched papers is at least 4-5 out of 6 to prevent partial completion from scoring too high
